text:
Site 1 "State College East": Centre County, PA. 150 MW solar + 75 MW storage, COD 2031. Greenfield next to a creek with mapped wetlands along the route. Route is 7 miles across 5 parcels. Homes border two sides, and residents spoke against solar at a township meeting.
Site 2 "Kenton Fields": Hardin County, OH. 100 MW solar, COD 2030. Farmland. We don't know the route or the neighbors yet.
Site 3 "Bay Breeze": Talbot County, MD. 50 MW solar on farmland.

site.name: State College East
site.notes: Creek nearby; mapped wetlands along route.

drivers.label: Elevated upgrade risk
drivers.reason: County studies rank at the 81st percentile; half exceeded the threshold.

drivers.label: Shared upgrade exposure
drivers.reason: Two shared substations and a 3.6-times cost spread heighten reallocation risk.

drivers.label: Complex connection route
drivers.reason: Five parcels to cross exceeds the higher-risk route threshold.

drivers.label: Wetlands and local siting
drivers.reason: Wetlands and municipal siting authority raise permitting risk.

drivers.label: Community opposition signals
drivers.reason: Local objections are reported, and nearby homes add scrutiny.

card.next_action: Resolve wetland and route feasibility first

result.summary: No statewide siting authority for solar. Municipal zoning ordinances decide where projects can go. Construction disturbing 1+ acre needs a DEP NPDES stormwater permit.

site.name: Kenton Fields
site.notes: Route and nearby neighbors are unknown.

drivers.label: Midrange study history
drivers.reason: 44th percentile of PJM studies across four county studies.

drivers.label: Shared upgrade exposure
drivers.reason: Three shared substations and 408 MW raise restudy exposure.

drivers.label: Route unknown
drivers.reason: Distance and parcels to cross are unknown.

drivers.label: Farmland siting risk
drivers.reason: Farmland faces county veto under Ohio's large-solar rules.

drivers.label: Community unknown
drivers.reason: Nearby homes and objections are unknown; county withdrawals trail state.

card.next_action: Confirm route and county siting restrictions

result.summary: Projects of 50 MW or more need an OPSB certificate. Under SB 52 (2021), county commissioners can ban large solar in unincorporated areas and sit on the OPSB panel for the case.

portfolio.headline: Advance Kenton Fields selectively; deprioritize State College East given its concentrated high-risk ratings.
